{"command":"git add -A && git status --short && git commit -q -F - <<'EOF'
Add CI, rewrite the documentation from keys.go

Close the last two Phase 0 items:

- CI runs gofmt, go vet, golangci-lint (standard linters) and the tests
  with -race on every push and on pull requests from forks. The tests
  get a tmpfs as TWIN_XDEV_DIR, so the real cross-device move runs, and
  the job fails if that test skips.
- DOCUMENTATION.md is rewritten from keys.go and the code: every key,
  the keys of each popup, what copy, move and delete do (including
  their failure modes), and the known limitations. docs_test.go fails
  when its shortcut table and keys.go disagree.

Clearing the lint findings removes unused styles and a dead
assignment, and makes the clipboard fallback report a failed OSC 52
write instead of dropping it. Only unchecked Close is excluded from
errcheck.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
git log --oneline -1 && git push -u origin finish-phase0 2>&1 | tail -3","description":"Commit changes and push the branch","timeout":120000}
